in_sanskrit.name: Adiant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immutable, unchanging
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Adiant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘adhi’ meaning 'towards' and ‘ant’ meaning 'end'. The name Adiant signifies that which is immutable or unchanging, something that remains constant and unyielding.
